Independently derived: amine half typed by hand from Fig 2a (p.5), 5-carbon linker from Fig 1b (p.3), sterol taken VERBATIM from provenance/reagent_registry.json (cholest-5-en-3beta-ol, InChIKey HVYWMOMLDIMFJA-DPAQBDIFSA-N), assembled by string substitution with no RWMol/AddBond/RemoveAtom anywhere -- see make_reference.py.
